verdict.rationale: Temporal exposes a CLI/SDK and gRPC API for core operations (workflow list, namespace management, cloud control-plane resources) that mirror much of what the Web UI shows, but there's no documented guarantee of full UI/API parity, and probes found no public OpenAPI/REST spec (404s across candidate paths). missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, a REST/OpenAPI spec, and confirmation that every UI action (e.g., debugging views, visualizations) has an API equivalent.
